effect.en: Causes 1/8 max HP in damage each turn during strong sunlight, but heals for 1/8 max HP during rain.  Increases damage from Fire moves to 1.25×, but absorbs Water moves, healing for 1/4 max HP.

flavor.en: Restores the Pokémon's HP in rain or when it is hit by Water-type moves. Reduces HP in harsh sunlight, and increases the damage received from Fire-type moves.
flavor.ko: 비가 오는 날씨나 물타입의 기술로 HP가 회복되고 맑을 때나 불꽃타입의 기술로는 줄어든다.
